reason: 该插件主要面向会话上下文增强，提供跨会话共享的持久记忆服务，并通过固定的 memory_* 工具供 Agent 调用，在检索与记录信息上实现会话间记忆延续。README 与仓库结构还说明了配套的 Web Memory 面板用于人机管理，但其核心功能仍集中于记忆读写与检索，不是搜索、构建或测试类工具。

summaries.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的共享持久记忆插件，提供 memory_add、memory_search、memory_list、memory_remove 工具，并附带 Web 侧边栏供用户查看、搜索、添加和删除记忆条目。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin for shared persistent memory that provides memory_add, memory_search, memory_list, and memory_remove tools, plus a web sidebar for viewing, searching, adding, and deleting memory entries.

capabilities: Persistent local memory storage with shared access across DSH sessions
Agent tools for adding, searching, listing, and removing memory entries
Web sidebar UI for manual memory management

reasons.code: README describes a shared persistent memory store in a single JSON file used by web/headless/any workspace sessions.
README lists Agent tool APIs memory_add, memory_search, memory_list, and memory_remove with their input parameters.
Tree shows dedicated store and client modules (src/store.js, lib/client.js) plus Cordis patch integration for DSH.
